fields.why: There are many instances of COS feeder trips that occur due to high bin levels. As a result, this will cause a reduction in the throughput for extended periods of time.
fields.design:
If both 222-FE-010/510, HPGR 1, and HPGR 2 are running, and all the COS feeders trips, audible alarm to engage. Alarm to state that all COS feeders are off with plant feed running.

Alarm is to be a short horn sound if possible. Happy to amend this if there are better suggestions to avoid excessive audibles – could also factor in throughput deviation from SP.
fields.impact: CROs get an audible prompt when all COS feeders stop while the plant is still fed.
